blocks.html: Still less can one allege the dissimilarity between the said accused and Sanxi Guerre, son of Martin: for besides that such judgments by resemblance (as has been often said above) are not very sure, there is a contrary summary inquiry upon the resemblance of the prisoner with the sisters of Martin Guerre, and one more probable, inasmuch as the likeness is with a greater number of persons, and such as are of like age, or very nearly, with him to whom the comparison is made.
